topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I can't believe I found this old, faded card from Mark, tucked away with an envelope stuffed full of crisp, rare stamps. It's been years, and I never thought... He must have remembered how much I loved collecting. I rush to the window, staring out at the rain, thinking about all the times we spent talking about different parts of the world, each stamp a tiny piece of it. My hands tremble a bit as I carefully look over each one, a gallery of memories. I need to call him, to thank him, but the words feel stuck. What do I even say to someone who gives you a piece of your past?
